archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury) adapted for Light Theme with Crimson
design_vision: A premium, editorial-style travel and vacation club platform. Combining the high-end emotional storytelling of luxury brands with the functional clarity of modern SaaS (Airbnb-style layouts) for the member and admin dashboards. The design uses crisp white space, striking crimson red accents, and elegant typography.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-heading text-foreground
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-heading text-foreground
rules.small_labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-body font-semibold text-muted-foreground

typography.instructions: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Apply tight letter spacing for headings. Use fluid typography scaling.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers must have internal padding.

grid_system.marketing: Mode A 'Tetris Grid'. Use asymmetrical layouts. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
grid_system.dashboard: Mode B 'Control Room Grid'. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Every pixel utilized.

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and paragraphs. Center-align only for specific hero messaging. Mobile-first layout.

components_strategy.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full or rounded-xl. Include smooth hover scaling (-translate-y-0.5) and box-shadow.
components_strategy.cards: Subtle border (border-border), rounded-2xl, no shadow by default. On hover: shadow-xl border-border/80.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, DatePicker. Customize with rounded-xl, light border, focus:ring-primary.
components_strategy.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-border/40.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top navigation. Z-50. Must be visible on desktop (no hidden hamburger). Links use hover:text-primary transition-colors.
components_strategy.badges: For star ratings and status: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-accent text-accent-foreground font-medium.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactives must have explicit hover states. Button hover: transform translate-y-[-2px] shadow-md transition-all duration-300.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use transition-all duration-300 ease-out for most state changes.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Fade-in entrance animations for grid items (staggered).

media.instructions: Main agent MUST use these exact URLs. Do not use placeholders.

images.description: Aerial shot of tropical beach resort
Woman on dock, representing vacation experiences

public_website.home: Hero section with beach image, search bar for trips (Country/Date/Guests). Featured packages grid.
public_website.search_results: Airbnb-style grid, cards with image, star rating, price in Quetzales (Q.), 'Ver Viaje' button.
public_website.trip_detail: Large hero image gallery, rich description, pricing breakdown, and quote request form.

member_portal.login: Minimalist layout, authenticates via Contract Number + DPI.
member_portal.dashboard: Bento grid showing service years, active promotions, announcements, quotations history, and messaging system for vacation requests.

admin_crm.dashboard: High density 'Control Room' grid. Table for members, packages list.
admin_crm.package_creator: Form to manage package details (image upload simulation, description, pricing, country).
admin_crm.communications: Push notifications manager, quotation responses, and WhatsApp number configuration module.

global_elements.whatsapp_widget: Floating action button in bottom right corner using brand primary color.

testing.rules: All interactive elements, forms, and cards MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'submit-quote-button', 'trip-card-1').
